column1: # HOW MAINTAINERS ADD ANY NEW CHIP IN 10 SECONDS (ZERO COMPILER RECOMPILE NEEDED):
# Copy any row below, change the columns to match the new chip's datasheet, and save.
# `resir_cc` reads this file at runtime on every run — no code changes required.
#  1. id        : Unique CLI target name (e.g. intel-xe2, apple-m, future-chip-2030)
#  2. vendor    : Chip maker (NVIDIA, Intel, AMD, Apple, ARM, Qualcomm, RISC-V, Universal)
#  4. exec      : Execution style: 0 = CPU (scalar+SIMD), 1 = GPU (SIMT warp), 2 = NPU (systolic)
#  6. backend   : Code generator: apple-m | arm64-linux | x64-linux | rv64-elf | wasm | spirv | intel-xe | sm121 | contract-only
#  9. smem      : Fast on-chip scratchpad/shared memory in bytes (0 for cache-coherent CPUs)
# 11. l1_kb     : L1 data cache per core/SM (KiB)
